_readme: First read of Irvine Valley College's program maps (S336, SkyCourier). The registry records IVC's sequence source as open: its own All Program Maps page (www.ivc.edu/node/3220, probe run 37198225537). No pilot college publishes a readable term sequence (Miramar's mapper refuses the reader), so this read learns how IVC publishes a map (a page or a PDF per program, how terms are named) and which programs have one, before a program is picked for the first term-by-term record. IVC's only articulated local course in MAP is ART 85 Life Drawing I (165 students), listed in the Art A.A. (10265) and the Studio Arts AA-T (32812, 45862); the follow pattern reads those maps if the index links them.

questions.map_index: How IVC publishes its program maps: one page or PDF per program, grouped how, and which programs have one.
questions.map_shape: How one IVC map names its terms (Semester 1, Fall, Year 1) and lists its courses, read on an Art or Studio Arts map.
